subject: alt-ft
title: ALT.FT.------WO.EXP.PRI.
description: Diagram in ALT(FT)II-18, second of two on book p124, paired with v3-p124-1, on the page where Braxton argues that 'as such, the emergence of alternative functionalism has relevance as a composite transformational tool for the total planet. The seriousness of the next cycle demands that this phenomenon is understood on some level.' (C)ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) is crossed with WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle): the question is what alternative-functionalism produces when crossed with the world-expansion-principle, in the context where alternative-functionalism IS being positioned as the composite transformational tool. RE-ST (restructuralism) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) form upper structure. INFO-TRNS (information transference) and ALT-D (alternative definitions) are right-side outputs. C-INFO (composite information) feeds the central. ACT (activism), POL-DY (political dynamics), MT-INFO (multi-information), and P-FC (particular focus) form the lower constituting layer. Structural argument: alternative-functionalism crossed with world-expansion-principle produces restructuralism and projectional-dynamics as upper outputs and information-transference / alternative-definitions as right-side outputs — Braxton's diagrammatic claim that real alternative-functionalism (as the composite-transformational tool) requires both restructural and projectional dimensions, with information-transference and alternative-definitions as the productive results.
